offering_description.value: H2O America supplies drinking water and provides wastewater service to households, businesses and public agencies. Its local utilities operate water treatment and distribution systems and provide wastewater collection and treatment in some service areas.

primary_services.value: water treatment and distribution; wastewater collection and treatment; contract utility operations and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2C: households in utility service areas; B2B: commercial and industrial water and sewer customers; B2G: municipalities and other public agencies

end_markets.value: residential water and sanitation; commercial properties; industrial facilities; municipal services

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: metered water consumption and wastewater usage where billed by volume; service fees: fixed water and sewer charges under utility tariffs; project or contract: operation and maintenance of water and wastewater systems for other owners
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: treats source water and operates local networks serving households, businesses and public agencies; service provider: operates and maintains water and wastewater systems for other owners

geography_served.value: US regional: California, Connecticut, Maine and Texas

specialization.value: related lines: drinking water supply, wastewater utilities and contract system operations

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: local utility subsidiaries connect and bill customers directly; other: water mains and sewer networks connect directly to customer properties

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state utility regulators oversee rates and service, and federal and state agencies enforce drinking water and discharge standards

notes: The current scope of nonregulated contract operations is uncertain.
